parameter_value: Exact ADP dp_id from frozen public metadata, without .fits; URL-encode query value.
response_kind_expected: Header-only viewer response; implementation accepts validated FITS-card plaintext or HTML PRE content. Actual header MIME/rendering has not yet been probed.
primary_or_raw: ID controls product identity: ADP requests the processed product; HARPS raw identifier requests raw frame. Require returned primary ARCFILE to match requested ADP, never substitute raw header.
primary_hdu: Service may render one or multiple HDUs; primary is first SIMPLE...END block. Required BERV/provenance fields must come from that primary block. HDU selection is not documented by reviewed sources and will be validated, not assumed.
unit: km/s, consistent with official HARPS drs_berv schema and existing local acquisition convention; retain signed recorded value.

limits_proposed.cap_origin: Project bounds revised before target headers: existing saved primary has 250533 bytes as newline-card text; 512KiB provides viewer/extension allowance, not a guaranteed service maximum.

canary: First deterministic selected ID; stop all remaining requests if response is not recognized bounded header text or product identity is inconsistent.
selection_rule: For each target and month NUMBER1..12 across all years, latest eligible observation t_min, tie lex-smallest dp_id; HD122640 then HD135204, monthascending.
mode_rule: SPEC_RES115000 and HEFS STfalse required for automatic extrema; trueEGGSexcluded, missingunknownpending. ActualINS MODEretained.
payload_gate: Combined all_existing300 and passingnew BERV span strictly greater than299792.458/115000km/s; descriptive displacement benchmark only.
